projects.name: 3look
projects.description:
3look is an AI-powered application that allows users to create and publish content for social media, mainly memes and GIF images, with the ability to publish directly on platforms like X (formerly Twitter) for performance-based rewards.

It represents a content creator studio where users generate branded or custom content using AI tools to quickly generate ideas, replace faces with NFT or crypto assets and publish, while the AI evaluation system transparently assesses impact, distributing revenue without requiring constant interaction.

Designed as a SocialFi project on ApeChain within the ApeCoin ecosystem, it turns user-created content into blockchain-rewarding assets, with partnerships expanding to networks like Ice Open Network for decentralized social layers.

projects.name: 42 (prev. Alkimiya)
projects.description: 42 is a protocol designed for creating, trading, and settling synthetic resources of the blockchain space through peer-to-peer smart contracts. Public blockchains have limited transaction capabilities, leading to competition and fee fluctuations. 42 addresses this by transforming key blockchain resources, such as average transaction fee, into tradeable assets, enabling better pricing and resource allocation. This system benefits various users: miners can secure future income by selling transaction fees, service providers like wallets and exchanges can hedge against fee volatility by buying them, and builders can compensate for high mining costs. The protocol design improves forecasting and managing settlement costs in the network, changing how blockchain networks approach resource allocation and pricing.

projects.name: Action Model
projects.description:
Action Model is developing a community-owned Large Action Model (LAM) — an AI system designed to perform real digital tasks on computers by interacting with graphical user interfaces (GUI), rather than just generating text like traditional Large Language Models (LLM). It tracks screen states, decides on actions (such as clicking coordinates, typing text, or scrolling) using its own action tree built from user contributions, executes these actions, and loops until the task is completed. This enables autonomous workflow automation like data entry, website navigation, or app work without using APIs.

The project fights centralized AI development by big tech companies through community contribution: users install a browser extension for passive or active training and create/sell reusable workflows on a marketplace where execution earns creators ongoing rewards.

The Actionist desktop app serves as the user interaction tool, allowing users to create specialized AI agents (digital employees with memory, schedule, personality traits, and tool access) that run locally or in the cloud 24/7, with full history tracking for transparency.

$LAM is the native token that powers actions, rewards training and contribution, provides governance, and represents ownership share in the AI system.
